title: Friendly Airports for Mothers Improvement Act
official_summary:
Friendly Airports for Mothers Improvement Act

This bill requires small hub airports to maintain a lactation area for nursing mothers and a baby changing table in at least one men's and one women's restroom in each passenger terminal building of the airport.

Currently, medium and large hub airports must comply with this requirement by FY2021. The bill requires small hub airports to be in compliance by FY2023.
